display.purpose: Hero headlines and brand moments only; italic for emphasis.

headline.purpose: Section titles and major page headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, dialog headers, list-group labels — work surfaces stay sans.

label.purpose: Émeraude pill badge and small status caps — a branded device, not a per-section eyebrow.

shadows.name: resting-card
shadows.purpose: Default lift for cards/panels in the light world (Tailwind shadow-sm).

shadows.name: soft-float
shadows.purpose: Raised moments — featured cards, hover lift, popovers. Diffuse and light.

shadows.name: dark-world-card
shadows.purpose: Digital card and dark-surface panels against onyx.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default ease-out-quint for entrances and state changes; no bounce/elastic.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Mandatory prefers-reduced-motion path; halo-holo and halo-sheen disable entirely.

components.name: Primary CTA (marketing)
components.description: The émeraude pill that drives every marketing conversion ('Créer ma carte').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #0D6B5E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A574C; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0D6B5E; }

components.name: Primary Button (in-app)
components.description: Compact émeraude action inside the dashboard/app.
components.css: .ds-btn-app { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #0D6B5E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-app:hover { background: #0A574C; } .ds-btn-app:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The quiet 'not the one action' control — back, cancel, filter.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E0F11; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #E6E1D5; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F3F0E9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(13,107,94,0.25); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Calcaire-filled field with warm hairline; border shifts émeraude on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #F3F0E9; color: #0E0F11; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #E6E1D5; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9B9DA0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0D6B5E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(13,107,94,0.25); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard light-world container — white on calcaire, warm hairline, flat at rest.
components.html:
Ma carte

Votre carte de fidélité est active.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E6E1D5; border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 30px -12px rgba(14,15,17,0.18); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #0E0F11; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: #6E7073; margin: 0; }

components.name: Label Pill (badge)
components.description: The branded émeraude cap badge — the one deliberate uppercase device.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: #0D6B5E; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Reward Flash (signature)
components.description: The full-screen gold moment when a customer earns a reward — the only place gold appears.
components.css: .ds-reward { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 160px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #F4D9A0 0%, #E8B964 45%, #C9952F 100%); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; } .ds-reward-label { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 28px; color: #0E0F11; }

narrative.overview: HALO is the halo of warm light over a well-kept Geneva shop counter. The dark onyx ground is the dim of the shop; émeraude is the steady, trustworthy glow of the brand and every primary action; gold is the single warm flare reserved for the moment a customer earns a reward. The personality is Clair · Élégant · Vibrant — Swiss-French restraint with a craftsman's warmth, Fraunces serif for identity and Inter for the workflow, generous density, flat surfaces at rest.
keyCharacteristics: Two grounded surface worlds: onyx-dark for brand/marketing, calcaire-light for the working app.
Émeraude is the one steady voice; gold is rationed to the reward beat alone.
Flat by default — depth via tonal layering and warm hairlines, not shadow.
Serif (Fraunces) for identity, sans (Inter) for the workflow; Swiss-French copy.
Counter-first ergonomics: big, forgiving, unmistakable primary actions.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Émeraude is the only color that signals action. There is never more than one primary émeraude element per section; everything else recedes to neutral.

rules.name: The Rationed Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is forbidden outside the reward moment. It is not a secondary brand color, highlight, or chart hue. Its rarity is the point — it must mean 'you earned this' every time.

rules.name: The Serif-Says-Who, Sans-Says-What Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for identity and emotion (heroes, brand headlines); Inter is for the job (titles, body, labels, forms). Never set body or controls in serif; never set a hero in sans.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px line-warm/onyx-line border before a shadow. If a card needs separation, the warm hairline does it. Shadow is the second resort.

dos: Do keep émeraude (#0D6B5E) as the single action color — one primary per section.
Do ration gold (#E8B964) to the reward moment only; it is not a brand color.
Do define cards and fields with the warm 1px hairline before reaching for shadow.
Do use galet-ink (#6E7073), not galet (#9B9DA0), for muted body text on light grounds — galet fails AA at body size.
Do set identity in Fraunces and the working UI in Inter.
Do keep motion 150–300ms, transform/opacity, with a prefers-reduced-motion path for every animation.
Do write copy in Swiss-French (vouvoiement), direct artisan tone, lucide icons only, no emoji.
donts: Don't ship the generic SaaS template — no cream/sand backgrounds, gradient blobs, hero-metric panels, or identical icon-card grids.
Don't go loud fintech/crypto — no neon-on-black, decorative glassmorphism, or aggressive gradients.
Don't go cold enterprise — no navy-and-gray dense soulless dashboards.
Don't go childish loyalty app — no mascots, candy primaries, or badge confetti.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent; use the full hairline, a tonal fill, or nothing.
Don't use background-clip:text gradient text or per-section uppercase eyebrows — the label cap is one deliberate branded device.
Don't tint a near-white background warm and call it the brand; warmth lives in type and the gold flare, not in default-tinting every surface.
Don't nest a card inside a card, or stack shadows for depth — layer tonally instead.
